title: MSc in Fintech | NCI

sections.heading: MSc in Fintech
sections.text:
The MSc in Fintech programme was designed to provide students with the essential skills in Financial Technologies covering a variety of topics from both business and technical domains. Students will be familiarised with (i) the technical landscape of fintech domains, such as, classical, advanced, and state-of-the-art financial techniques and analytics methods including their theoretical foundations and mathematical underpinnings, and (ii) the deep understanding of impacts, design, application, and operationalisation of fintech solutions in business contexts.
NCI is perfectly placed to deliver an industry-focused programme inspired by its location at the heart of the International Financial Services Centre. The course is completely delivered by faculty and industry practitioners with established experience in the fintech domain.
Course details
This course typically appeals to those who possess a level 8 qualification in any discipline and wish to transfer to a career in fintech.
Note that the course is technical in nature and entails a significant amount of independent study. Given the content and the timescale learners need to have a strong commitment to the course and a willingness to fully engage with the technical content.
This interdisciplinary course will appeal to graduates of finance, computing and business seeking to enter the area of fintech; and industry practitioners seeking to gain insightful experience and exposure to the principles of fintech, as well as data analytics and emerging technologies. Specifically, learners would have opportunity to choose between two learning paths: programming learning path and non-programming learning path. In addition to the core modules, the programming learning path will offer subjects such as Machine Learning for Finance and Programming for Financial Data Science, while the non-programming learning path will offer modules such as Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Fintech, and Leadership, Organisation Culture and Human Factors in Fintech.
The programme aims to produce high-quality, technically competent, innovative graduates that will become leading practitioners in the field of Financial Technologies. Upon completion of this course, graduates will be able to:
Synthesize and critically evaluate expert knowledge of governance and compliance, data analysis and visualisation, cybersecurity and IT auditing, big data analytics, high level as well as deep financial data analysis skills, adapting artificial intelligence and machine learning in fintech, techniques and technologies of fintech utilised in both technical and business contexts.
Formulate, design, assess, and implement effective business and technical solutions and strategies for the fintech domain based on the latest industry practices and standards to enhance human potential and customer support.
Contextualise and integrate future, emerging, and disruptive technologies in fintech.
Critically assess and evaluate ethical, sustainable, and responsible risks and impacts associated with technological and strategic solutions in fintech domain. Demonstrate competencies in legal practices and regulations in fintech.
Critically evaluate and optimise entrepreneurship, business, and technical strategies for the fintech domain. Acquire and develop a comprehensive skill set in leadership and collaboration in order to actualise entrepreneurship and innovation in fintech.
The fintech industry is growing at a fast pace and the global Fintech-as-a-Service Market size is expected to reach $681.6 billion by 2028. Organisations such as Financial Services in Ireland – Skills of the Future, ICTSkillnet Report 2022, Expert Group on Future Skills Needs (EGFSN) have reported a huge market need for graduates with skills in finance and financial technologies in Ireland.
Core Modules
Blockchain Technologies
Financial Markets
Data Governance, Ethics and Sustainability
AI for Finance
Financial Regulations
Payments and Transaction Services
Research Elective
Practicum OR
Internship
In addition, there is the choice of two electives.
Elective Modules
Programming for Financial Data Science
Leadership, Organisational Culture, and Human Factors in Fintech
Machine Learning for Finance
Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Fintech
Note that there are dependencies between some electives. To study Machine Learning for Finance elective in semester 2, students must have studied Programming for Financial Data Science elective module in semester 1. However, all the students can elect to study Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Fintech.
Elective modules are subject to availability and a minimum number of students required to run a module.
Assessment
The course will be assessed with a blend of project work and exams. This varies between modules but typically assessment is 50% continuous assessment and 50% exam.
For information on the modules taught on this course view our module descriptors.
The Master of Science in Fintech is awarded by QQI at level 9 on the National Framework for Qualifications. Students who successfully complete this course may progress to a major award at level 10 on the NFQ, such as a PhD.
A level 8 degree (2.2 award) or its equivalent in one or more of the following domains: computer science, finance, business, or economics. Cognate disciplines will also be considered. Note that applicants lacking both a clear financial and technology component may still be eligible but are subject to review.
The College operates a Recognition of Prior Experiential Learning (RPEL) scheme - meaning applicants who do not meet the normal academic entry requirements, may be considered based on relevant work or other experience.
Non-English speaking applicants must demonstrate fluency in the English language as demonstrated by an IELTS academic score of at least 6.0 or equivalent. Visit our English Language Requirements page for further information.
National College of Ireland has implemented a Bring Your Own Device policy for all courses. Specifically, students are expected to successfully participate in lectures, laboratories and projects using a portable computer (laptop/notebook) with a substantial hardware configuration.
The recommended configuration is as follows:
Processor:
Intel 11th Gen or newer, Core i3 / i5 /i7 or Ultra 3 / 5 /7 Or
AMD 5000 Series or newer, Rzyen 3 / 5 /7
Random Access Memory (RAM): 16GB or greater
Storage: SSD (Solid State Drive) 256GB or greater
Wireless Card: 802.11 n/ac/ax capability
Recommended Operating Systems: Windows 11 Later Version of MAC OS should also be fine. Chromebook’s are not recommended.
It is the responsibility of the student to ensure their computer is functioning correctly and that they have full administrator rights. NCI cannot provide support for these personal devices.
A Laptop Loan Scheme is available for eligible students to assist them in completing their chosen course.
Two evenings per week 18.00 - 22.00 and every second Saturday.
Please note that in some instances exams may take place in the daytime, evening, and/or at weekends.
Blended - Livestream with some on-campus stream classes, scheduled in advance.
See the MSc in Fintech course brochure for an explanation of the learning methods.
This course runs over 2 years; 4 semesters with an internship/practicum.
€4,800 per annum (€9,600 total fee).
(Fees revised annually)
You can spread the cost of this course with a direct debit plan.
We offer a range of scholarship opportunities and discount offers available to both NCI and non-NCI graduates that will help you access this course.

Formulate, design, assess, and implement effective business and technical solutions and strategies for the fintech domain based on the latest industry practices and standards to enhance human potential and customer support.
Contextualise and integrate future, emerging, and disruptive technologies in fintech.
Critically assess and evaluate ethical, sustainable, and responsible risks and impacts associated with technological and strategic solutions in fintech domain. Demonstrate competencies in legal practices and regulations in fintech.
Critically evaluate and optimise entrepreneurship, business, and technical strategies for the fintech domain. Acquire and develop a comprehensive skill set in leadership and collaboration in order to actualise entrepreneurship and innovation in fintech.
Career Prospects
The fintech industry is growing at a fast pace and the global Fintech-as-a-Service Market size is expected to reach $681.6 billion by 2028. Organisations such as Financial Services in Ireland – Skills of the Future, ICTSkillnet Report 2022, Expert Group on Future Skills Needs (EGFSN) have reported a huge market need for graduates with skills in finance and financial technologies in Ireland.

Core Modules
Blockchain Technologies
Financial Markets
Data Governance, Ethics and Sustainability
AI for Finance
Financial Regulations
Payments and Transaction Services
Research Elective
Practicum OR
Internship
In addition, there is the choice of two electives.
Elective Modules
Programming for Financial Data Science
Leadership, Organisational Culture, and Human Factors in Fintech
Machine Learning for Finance
Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Fintech
Note that there are dependencies between some electives. To study Machine Learning for Finance elective in semester 2, students must have studied Programming for Financial Data Science elective module in semester 1. However, all the students can elect to study Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Fintech.
Elective modules are subject to availability and a minimum number of students required to run a module.

sections.heading: Higher Diploma in Science in Data Analytics (International)
sections.text:
The overall goal of the Higher Diploma in Science in Data Analytics programme is to provide graduates with essential research and development skills in Data Analytics.
It is envisaged that graduates from this programme will be well equipped to perform independent research that enables them to make informed and critical decisions regarding requirements elicitation and analysis, implementation, evaluation, and documentation in Data Analytics.
International students can apply for this course by selecting a start date below:
January 2026
If you have any queries, please contact our International Team by emailing international@ncirl.ie.
Course details
This programme seeks to produce graduates who are able to provide insight, gain value and discover knowledge (at an organisational, societal, or personal level) from data through exercising the skills that are developed through the programmes.
Upon completion of this course, graduates will be able to:
Develop statistical skills to carry out effective data analyses using descriptive and inferential statistics within a business context.
Conduct substantial and extensive independent research and analysis in the field of Data Analytics.
Formulate and implement a novel research idea using the latest industry practices.
Demonstrate expert knowledge and a critical understanding of data analysis, statistics, and the tools, techniques and technologies of Data Analytics utilised in both technical and business contexts.
Critically assess, evaluate and communicate business technical strategies for Data Analytics.
Formulate, design, assess, and implement effective business technical solutions for Data Analytics.
Critically assess and evaluate security, privacy, sustainability, and ethical issues associated with the storage, transfer, and processing of data for analytical purposes.
The course will be delivered using academic research, industry-defined practical problems, and case studies. This approach will naturally foster a deeper knowledge of the subject area and create transferable skills for work such as critical thinking, problem-solving, creative thinking, communication, teamwork, and research skills. The course is completely delivered by faculty and industry practitioners with proven expertise in data analytics.
This course will appeal to non-technical professionals and college graduates from non-technical disciplines who wish to upgrade their skills or simply advance their career in the domain of Data Analytics. The programme is particularly suitable for those with numeracy and analytical skills. You do not need to have previously studied programming. However, given the content and the timeframe you will need to have a strong commitment to the course and willingness to fully engage with the technical content.
2021 Graduates used the course to upskill or gain employment in roles such as Collection & Payable Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Process & Data Analyst, Junior Data Specialist, Scalability Analyst, OSM Planner, Trading Analyst, Market Specialist, Business Analyst.
Companies who hired from 2022 graduates of the Higher Diploma in Data Analytics include: Central Bank of Ireland (Statistics Analyst), Intel (Optimization Engineer), Commission for Communications Regulation (Business Analyst), Netscout (Principal Service Engineer), Pfizer (Data Scientist),Coinbase (Compliance Analyst), TikTok (Quality Analyst), Global Shares (Business Reporting Analyst), Citi (Digital Client Support), Enterprise Ireland (Senior Technologist), VHI (Data Analyst), Pinergy (Data Analyst).
Applicants will normally have an equivalent to an Irish Level 8 Honours in any discipline will be considered.

Description:
Higher Diploma in Science in Data Analytics (International)
Duration:
1 year
NFQ Level:
Level 8
The overall goal of the Higher Diploma in Science in Data Analytics programme is to provide graduates with essential research and development skills in Data Analytics.
It is envisaged that graduates from this programme will be well equipped to perform independent research that enables them to make informed and critical decisions regarding requirements elicitation and analysis, implementation, evaluation, and documentation in Data Analytics.
How to Apply
International students can apply for this course by selecting a start date below:
January 2026
If you have any queries, please contact our International Team by emailing
international@ncirl.ie
.
Course details
Course Description
This programme seeks to produce graduates who are able to provide insight, gain value and discover knowledge (at an organisational, societal, or personal level) from data through exercising the skills that are developed through the programmes.
Upon completion of this course, graduates will be able to:
Develop statistical skills to carry out effective data analyses using descriptive and inferential statistics within a business context.
Conduct substantial and extensive independent research and analysis in the field of Data Analytics.
Formulate and implement a novel research idea using the latest industry practices.
Demonstrate expert knowledge and a critical understanding of data analysis, statistics, and the tools, techniques and technologies of Data Analytics utilised in both technical and business contexts.
Critically assess, evaluate and communicate business technical strategies for Data Analytics.
Formulate, design, assess, and implement effective business technical solutions for Data Analytics.
Critically assess and evaluate security, privacy, sustainability, and ethical issues associated with the storage, transfer, and processing of data for analytical purposes.
The course will be delivered using academic research, industry-defined practical problems, and case studies. This approach will naturally foster a deeper knowledge of the subject area and create transferable skills for work such as critical thinking, problem-solving, creative thinking, communication, teamwork, and research skills. The course is completely delivered by faculty and industry practitioners with proven expertise in data analytics.
Who is this course for?
This course will appeal to non-technical professionals and college graduates from non-technical disciplines who wish to upgrade their skills or simply advance their career in the domain of Data Analytics. The programme is particularly suitable for those with numeracy and analytical skills. You do not need to have previously studied programming. However, given the content and the timeframe you will need to have a strong commitment to the course and willingness to fully engage with the technical content.
Career Prospects
2021 Graduates used the course to upskill or gain employment in roles such as Collection & Payable Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Process & Data Analyst, Junior Data Specialist, Scalability Analyst, OSM Planner, Trading Analyst, Market Specialist, Business Analyst.
Companies who hired from 2022 graduates of the Higher Diploma in Data Analytics include: Central Bank of Ireland (Statistics Analyst), Intel (Optimization Engineer), Commission for Communications Regulation (Business Analyst), Netscout (Principal Service Engineer), Pfizer (Data Scientist),Coinbase (Compliance Analyst), TikTok (Quality Analyst), Global Shares (Business Reporting Analyst), Citi (Digital Client Support), Enterprise Ireland (Senior Technologist), VHI (Data Analyst), Pinergy (Data Analyst).

sections.heading: Welcome to National College of Ireland
sections.text:

The NCI International Pre-Arrival Programme is a bespoke programme designed to help you prepare and plan for a successful, safe and stress-free journey to Ireland. title: Welcome Programme

sections.heading: Starting at NCI
sections.text: The Welcome Programme is a combination of events designed to ensure new international students have all the information they need to help them settle into college life and get established in Ireland. The programme runs twice a year, one month before classes start in September and January. We encourage students to join as many events as possible to meet new people and settle in.

sections.heading: Welcome Programme Events
sections.text: We have prepared a mix of in-person and online events delivered to suit you wherever you are in Ireland or arriving shortly. There are three types of events which you can join. The first is a Welcome Meeting scheduled for everyone. The second is highly recommended and, lastly, optional to attend. Learn more about the sessions below:

sections.heading: Welcome Meeting
sections.text:
The Welcome Meeting is an in-person session where you meet with International Peer Mentors, current NCI students or recent graduates, and a small group of freshers like you. You will receive important information, a welcome pack, take a campus tour and ask questions in real-time.
Your Welcome Meeting is scheduled after you complete and send the Registration Form to International Student Support. Up to three days before the meeting, we will send your meeting's time, date and location to your personal email address.
Student Letters
Immigration and Welcome letter: The letters will be sent to you within 3 working days of the welcome meeting via your student email.

sections.heading: Highly Recommended Meetings
sections.text:
There are three highly recommended meetings we strongly suggest every student attend:
1. Essentials: at this meeting, you will receive information on registering with immigration, opening a bank account, getting your tax number (PPSN) and working in Ireland.
Date & Time: 9th January at 2pm
Location: Theatre 3 (Mayor Square campus, third floor)
Link to the presentation slides: see link here
2. Student Life: at this meeting, you will receive information on how to succeed in your studies, the support systems available at NCI, and how to adjust to student life.
Date & Time: 13th January at 2pm
Location: Theatre 3 (Mayor Square campus, third floor)
Link to the Presentation slides: see link here
3. Orientation: is organised by Student Services for all new students and is held the week before classes start. Students can expect an email from orientation@ncirl.ie with an invitation to join orientation. Orientation Information is also available on Full-time Registration and Orientation.

sections.heading: Optional Meetings
sections.text:
Optional meetings are events designed to help connect with new students and explore Dublin and Ireland. Join as many events as possible to meet new people and settle in. Optional meetings are:
Workshops sessions with practical tips and advice to get to grips with Ireland, for example: Accommodation Workshop, Getting Around, Wellness​, and Safety in Dublin
Meet-Up sessions allow you to meet with your international peer mentors and new students like you. It's a great way to break the ice and make friends, for example: Shopping in Dublin, Ice-Breakers, Irish Treats Tasting​, Board Games​
Excursions sessions are perfectly designed to help you discover and explore your new home, Dublin, Ireland. We will bring you on exciting adventures to tour around the city, countryside, even other counties. Examples: City Tours, Howth, Dun Laoghaire, and Glendalough

sections.heading: Welcome Programme Schedule: January 2026
sections.text:
The Welcome Programme for the January 2026 intake begins on 5th January and is designed to help you feel confident and supported as you start your journey with NCI.
The event schedule will be updated on this page every Friday, one week before each programme week begins. Students who have confirmed their place will also receive a reminder newsletter by email on the same day.
Reminder: All students need to plan to be in Ireland for classes starting on 19th January 2026.

title: English

sections.heading: Welcome to National College of Ireland (NCI)
sections.text:
Below you will find essential information on NCI including our programmes, scholarships and the support offered to you during your study experience.
We hope that you find this section helpful in your study abroad research. To discuss your options at NCI please contact us by email international@ncirl.ie.

sections.heading: About National College of Ireland
sections.text: NCI is a specialist college and provides a range of undergraduate, postgraduate and higher diploma programmes within our School of Business, School of Computing and Centre for Education and Lifelong Learning. All qualifications are globally recognised and you can be guaranteed exceptional quality and an excellent learning experience.

sections.heading: Programmes, Fees & Scholarships
sections.text:
For a list of all programmes available to international students please see below. You can read further details on each programme by visiting our programme pages.
All programmes commence in September each year with a number of Masters programmes also commencing in January. Our Undergraduate programmes are 3 years in duration in our School of Business and 4 years in duration in our School of Computing and Center for Education and Lifelong Learning. Masters and higher diploma programmes are typically one year in duration, with a slightly longer duration in the School of Business if starting in January.
School of Business
School of Computing
Center for Education and Lifelong Learning
Fees and Scholarships
NCI offers very competitive fees for international students. Scholarships are available on all programmes and are assessed during the application process. Therefore the first step to achieving a scholarship is to apply for your chosen programme. A full list of our fees and scholarships are available on the Fees and Funding pages.

sections.heading: Rankings, Accreditations & Quality
sections.text:
Quality and Qualifications Ireland (QQI) is the Awarding Body for the programmes offered by National College of Ireland. Our close partnership with QQI ensures that NCI’s undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are informed by the most current practices in quality assurance and delivered to the highest standards of academic integrity. You can find out more details on this relationship by visiting our Awarding Body page.
As well as our partnership with QQI, our programmes are accredited by some of the leading regulatory bodies within specific industries, including ACCA, CIPD, Chartered Accountants of Ireland and Psychological Society of Ireland. These accreditations acknowledge that NCI programmes are well regarded within these industries.
NCI was recently awarded 5 Stars in the QS Stars rating for Higher Education Institutions. This is the highest result you can achieve within the industry and reflects NCI’s commitment to providing quality in everything we do. NCI scored particularly well in the areas of graduate employment, internationalization, inclusiveness and facilities. You can find out more about NCI’s QS Stars achievement here.

sections.heading: Careers & Employability
sections.text:
NCI Careers Service
NCI understands the importance of providing students with good career options when they graduate – which is why we have a dedicated Careers Team that begin working with students from day one of their student journey in order to provide the direction, skills and knowledge to successfully identify and secure the right career. Our Careers team have won eight national awards in the last nine years – so you can be guaranteed that you will be provided with the best possible service. They arrange over one hundred careers events annually that connect students with potential employers and provide dedicated support with CV clinics and interview practice.
Graduate Outcomes
As a result of providing globally recognised, high-quality qualifications and the exceptional service of our careers department, it is no surprise that 86% of our graduates secure employment within 6 months of graduation. This is an exceptionally high result within the higher education industry and something that NCI is very proud of. Many of our graduates are now working with top multinationals in tech and financial services that have their headquarters in Dublin. To learn more about the success of our graduates please read our graduate destinations reports.
Graduate Work Visa
To support students when they graduate, the Government of Ireland offers one year working visa for undergraduate students and two years for postgraduate students after they graduate from NCI. This allows students to gain invaluable working experience in Ireland and is testament to our commitment to attracting and welcoming the most talented international students.

sections.heading: NCI Student Support
sections.text:
We understand that moving to a new country, where you might have no family or friends, can be daunting. The NCI International Office will ensure you have all the information, support and guidance you need from your arrival to Ireland until your graduation from NCI. The NCI international team won first place in The Education Awards 2021 for the International Engagement Award – testament to our commitment to providing outstanding student support.
Preparation Programme
From twelve weeks before the start of classes, we begin engaging with all applicants on the important information needed to help plan the journey to NCI and Ireland. Every week the international support team provides you with information and guides covering different topics such as accommodation, finances, careers, registration and starting at NCI. We hold weekly webinars, giving students the opportunity to ask questions or clear any doubts with the International support team and current NCI students.
Airport Collection
A free of charge airport shuttle service is available to students. Our team of drivers will meet you at the airport and safely transport you to your accommodation in Dublin, making your arrival to Ireland stress free and enjoyable.
Arrival and Welcome Programme
For new international students joining NCI in September or January of each year, the International Office runs a Welcome Programme. It is delivered over several weeks starting from the first week in September and January. The programme covers a wide range of essential topics and great activities that ensure students get off to the very best start for the year ahead and settle into college life in Dublin.
Academic Support Services
NCI is committed to ensuring every student feels supported in as many ways as possible, especially when it comes to academic success. NCI’s Learning Support Service is centered around core areas such as academic writing, reading, researching, studying, note-taking, exam revision and in general, a focus on aiding a student in all manners of academic advancement. Take a look at further information on our student support services.

sections.heading: Entry Requirements
sections.text:
Students from more than 80 countries study at our campus and we accept high school and degree qualifications from thousands of education institutions around the world.
For full details on the requirements for your country, including the specific grades you require, please visit our Country Pages.
Undergraduate Entry Requirements
We accept high school qualifications from around the world as well as A Level and International Baccalaureate qualifications. Our undergraduate programmes require you to have completed Mathematics and English subjects within your high school qualification and some programmes may have specific grade requirements.
Postgraduate Entry Requirements
Our masters programmes require students to have a bachelor degree (or international equivalent) from a recognised institution. To find out the accepted qualifications from your country as well as the required grades, please visit our Country Pages. In addition to the entry requirements from individual countries, certain courses also have cognate requirements. You should look at the programme pages for more information or email international@ncirl.ie
English Language Requirement
We accept a number of English language qualifications including IELTS, TOEFL and Duolingo. Please visit our English language requirements page for more details.

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.text:
National College of Ireland welcomes students from around the world and is here to support you on each step of your journey. It is advised that you consider applying through one of our approved agents who can provide you with additional guidance and support with your application. Please view our agents on our Country Pages. If you do not find an agent near you, please email us on international@ncirl.ie and we will connect you with an appropriate agent. We are happy to discuss your application and any questions you have. Please email us on international@ncirl.ie
If you wish to apply without an agent you can do so by using the "Apply Now" button on your chosen programme on our website.
For all applications, we require the following:
Official transcripts and graduation certificate of all study you have completed so far in both original language and English translation.
English language certificate (if available – if not this can be uploaded at a later date)
CV/Resume
Passport (if you are currently residing in Ireland we also require a copy of your immigration card)
For some programmes you will require the following:
A personal statement (required for BA (Hons) in Psychology, BA (Hons) in Accounting and Finance, BA (Hons) in Marketing Practice, MSc in Fintech)
A completed Marketing Task if applying to the MSc in Marketing

graduate destinations reports
.
Graduate Work Visa
To support students when they graduate, the Government of Ireland offers one year working visa for undergraduate students and two years for postgraduate students after they graduate from NCI. This allows students to gain invaluable working experience in Ireland and is testament to our commitment to attracting and welcoming the most talented international students.
NCI Student Support
We understand that moving to a new country, where you might have no family or friends, can be daunting. The NCI International Office will ensure you have all the information, support and guidance you need from your arrival to Ireland until your graduation from NCI. The NCI international team won first place in The Education Awards 2021 for the International Engagement Award – testament to our commitment to providing outstanding student support.
Preparation Programme
From twelve weeks before the start of classes, we begin engaging with all applicants on the important information needed to help plan the journey to NCI and Ireland. Every week the international support team provides you with information and guides covering different topics such as accommodation, finances, careers, registration and starting at NCI. We hold weekly webinars, giving students the opportunity to ask questions or clear any doubts with the International support team and current NCI students.
Airport Collection
A free of charge airport shuttle service is available to students. Our team of drivers will meet you at the airport and safely transport you to your accommodation in Dublin, making your arrival to Ireland stress free and enjoyable.
Arrival and Welcome Programme
For new international students joining NCI in September or January of each year, the International Office runs a Welcome Programme. It is delivered over several weeks starting from the first week in September and January. The programme covers a wide range of essential topics and great activities that ensure students get off to the very best start for the year ahead and settle into college life in Dublin.
Academic Support Services
NCI is committed to ensuring every student feels supported in as many ways as possible, especially when it comes to academic success. NCI’s Learning Support Service is centered around core areas such as academic writing, reading, researching, studying, note-taking, exam revision and in general, a focus on aiding a student in all manners of academic advancement. Take a look at further information on our
student support services
.
Entry Requirements
Students from more than 80 countries study at our campus and we accept high school and degree qualifications from thousands of education institutions around the world.
For full details on the requirements for your country, including the specific grades you require, please visit our
Country Pages
.
Undergraduate Entry Requirements
We accept high school qualifications from around the world as well as A Level and International Baccalaureate qualifications. Our undergraduate programmes require you to have completed Mathematics and English subjects within your high school qualification and some programmes may have specific grade requirements.
Postgraduate Entry Requirements
Our masters programmes require students to have a bachelor degree (or international equivalent) from a recognised institution. To find out the accepted qualifications from your country as well as the required grades, please visit our
Country Pages
. In addition to the entry requirements from individual countries, certain courses also have cognate requirements. You should look at the programme pages for more information or email
international@ncirl.ie
English Language Requirement
We accept a number of English language qualifications including IELTS, TOEFL and Duolingo. Please visit our
English language requirements page
for more details.
How to Apply
National College of Ireland welcomes students from around the world and is here to support you on each step of your journey. It is advised that you consider applying through one of our approved agents who can provide you with additional guidance and support with your application. Please view our agents on our
Country Pages
. If you do not find an agent near you, please email us on
international@ncirl.ie
and we will connect you with an appropriate agent. We are happy to discuss your application and any questions you have. Please email us on
international@ncirl.ie
If you wish to apply without an agent you can do so by using the "Apply Now" button on your chosen programme on our website.
For all applications, we require the following:
Official transcripts and graduation certificate of all study you have completed so far in both original language and English translation.
English language certificate (if available – if not this can be uploaded at a later date)
CV/Resume
Passport (if you are currently residing in Ireland we also require a copy of your immigration card)
For some programmes you will require the following:
A personal statement (required for BA (Hons) in Psychology, BA (Hons) in Accounting and Finance, BA (Hons) in Marketing Practice, MSc in Fintech)
A completed
Marketing Task
if applying to the MSc in Marketing

sections.heading: Bienvenido a la página en español del NCI
sections.text:
En NCI recibimos con los brazos abiertos a estudiantes de toda Latinoamérica. A continuación detallamos información esencial sobre NCI, incluyendo programas, becas y el apoyo que se ofrece al alumnado.
Esperamos que esta sección le resulte útil al momento de buscar un destino para estudiar en el extranjero. Si le interesa conocer las diferentes opciones más a detalle , puede contactarnos por correo electrónico en international@ncirl.ie
NCI es una institución de enseñanza superior especializada que ofrece un amplio abanico de programas de carrera universitaria, posgrado y diploma superior. Estos se imparten en nuestras facultades: Escuela de Negocios, Escuela de Computación y Centro de Educación y Formación Continua. Todos nuestros títulos están reconocidos a nivel mundial por lo que garantizamos una calidad excepcional y una excelente experiencia educativa.

sections.heading: Programas, tasas de matrícula y becas
sections.text:
Ver a continuación la lista de todos los programas que se ofrecen al alumnado internacional. Más información sobre cada uno de ellos en las programme pages.
Todos los programas comienzan en septiembre, si bien algunos de los programas de máster también lo hacen en enero. Nuestros programas de grado tienen una duración de 3 años en la Escuela de Negocios y de 4 años en la Escuela de Computación y en el Centro de Educación y Formación Continua. Los programas de máster y diploma superior tienen habitualmente una duración de un año, un poco más en la Escuela de Negocios si se comienza en enero.
Hay que tener en cuenta que los nombres de estos programas se han traducido del inglés para su comodidad. Con el fin de evitar cualquier confusión con la traducción, aconsejamos comprobar el nombre exacto del programa en inglés en las páginas dedicadas a los programas.
SEscuela de Negocios
Escuela de Computación
Centro de Educación y Formación Continua
Tasas de matrícula y becas
Las tasas de matrícula del NCI para estudiantes internacionales son muy competitivas. Además disponemos de becas para todos los programas, que se evalúan durante el proceso de solicitud. Por consiguiente, el primer paso para conseguir una beca es presentar la solicitud para el programa elegido. Las listas de nuestras tasas de matrícula y becas están disponibles en las páginas dedicadas a Tasas de Matrícula y Financiación.
¡Atención estudiantes de México! El NCI tiene un convenio con el FIDERH, un fideicomiso federal administrado por el Banco de México. Esta una gran oportunidad para solicitar un crédito para financiar sus estudios en el NCI. Más información en www.fiderh.org.mx/.

sections.heading: Rankings, acreditaciones y calidad
sections.text:
Quality and Qualifications Ireland (QQI) es el organismo que certifica los programas impartidos en el National College of Ireland. Nuestra estrecha colaboración con QQI garantiza que los programas de grado y posgrado del NCI estén avalados por las prácticas más actuales de control de calidad y que se impartan conforme a los más altos estándares de integridad académica. Más detalles aquí.
Además de QQI, nuestros programas están acreditados por los principales entes reguladores dentro de sectores específicos, como ACCA, CIPD, Censores Jurados de Cuentas de Irlanda [Chartered Accountants of Ireland]y la Sociedad de Psicología de Irlanda [Psychological Society of Ireland]. Estas acreditaciones confirman que los programas del NCI gozan de gran consideración en el seno de estos sectores.
El NCI recibió recientemente 5 Estrellas en la calificación QS Stars para instituciones de enseñanza superior. Es el máximo resultado que se puede alcanzar y refleja el compromiso del NCI de proporcionar calidad en todo lo que hacemos. El NCI obtuvo especialmente buenos resultados en las áreas de empleabilidad de sus graduados y egresados, internacionalización, inclusión e instalaciones. Más información sobre el resultado del NCI en QS Stars aquí.

sections.heading: Orientación laboral y empleabilidad
sections.text:
Servicio de Orientación Laboral del NCI
El NCI sabe lo importante que es proporcionar a sus estudiantes buenas opciones laborales cuando se gradúen. Por eso tenemos un Equipo de Orientación Laboral específico que comienza a trabajar con ellas desde el primer día de su trayectoria estudiantil, ofreciéndoles asesoramiento, destrezas y conocimiento para identificar y obtener con éxito la salida laboral más adecuada. Nuestro Equipo de Orientación Laboral ha ganado ocho galardones nacionales en los últimos nueve años. Así que pueden estar seguras de recibir el mejor servicio posible. Organizan más de cien eventos y ferias de empleo al año, que ponen en contacto a estudiantes y empresas. Además, brindan apoyo para elaborar el CV y prácticas para realizar las entrevistas de trabajo.
Salidas laborales
Dado que proporcionamos cualificaciones reconocidas a nivel mundial y de alta calidad, sin olvidar el excepcional servicio de nuestro Equipo de Orientación Laboral, no resulta sorprendente que el 86% de nuestras estudiantes encuentre empleo dentro de los 6 meses posteriores a su graduación. Se trata de un resultado excepcionalmente elevado dentro del sector de la enseñanza superior y algo de lo que el NCI se enorgullece. Gran cantidad de nuestras graduadas trabajan en grandes multinacionales de servicios financieros y tecnológicos con sede en Dublín. Más información sobre el éxito de nuestras graduadas en los informes sobre el rumbo de las graduadas.
Visado de trabajo para graduadas
El Gobierno de Irlanda ofrece un visado de trabajo de un año para estudiantes de grado y de dos años para estudiantes de posgrado después de graduarse en el NCI. Esto les permite adquirir una valiosísima experiencia laboral en Irlanda y demuestra nuestro compromiso a la hora de atraer y acoger a las estudiantes internacionales con más talento.

sections.heading: Apoyo al alumnado del NCI
sections.text:
Sabemos que mudarse a otro país, lejos de familiares y amigos, puede ser abrumador. La Oficina Internacional de NCI proporcional al alumnado toda la información, apoyo y asesoramiento que necesiten desde su llegada a Irlanda hasta su graduación. El equipo de la Oficina Internacional del NCI quedó en primer lugar en los Premios de la Educación 2021 para el Premio al Compromiso Internacional, lo que demuestra nuestra dedicación a la hora de proporcionar un apoyo excepcional a nuestro alumnado.
Programa de preparación
Doce semanas antes del comienzo de las clases, empezamos a compartir con las solicitantes la información importante que precisan para planificar el viaje al NCI y a Irlanda. Cada semana, el equipo de apoyo internacional proporciona información y orientación sobre diferentes temas, como alojamiento, finanzas, trabajo, matriculación y primeros pasos en el NCI. Organizamos seminarios web semanales para darles la oportunidad de hacer preguntas o aclarar dudas con el equipo de apoyo internacional y con estudiantes que ya han pasado por este proceso.
Traslado desde el aeropuerto
Hay un servicio de transporte desde el aeropuerto gratuito para el alumnado. Nuestro equipo de conductores traslada de manera segura a las estudiantes desde el aeropuerto a su alojamiento en Dublín, para que la llegada a Irlanda sea agradable y sin estrés.
Llegada y programa de bienvenida
El NCI tiene en marcha un programa de bienvenida para las nuevas estudiantes internacionales que se incorporan al NCI en septiembre o enero. Dura varias semanas y comienza en la primera semana de septiembre y enero. El programa cubre un amplio abanico de cuestiones esenciales e incluye interesantes actividades que ayudan a las estudiantes a empezar el curso con buen pie y a adaptarse la vida estudiantil en Dublín.
Servicio de Apoyo Académico
El NCI se compromete a garantizar que sus estudiantes se sientan apoyadas en todos los aspectos posibles, especialmente en lo relativo a su éxito académico. El Servicio de Apoyo Académico se centra en áreas clave del ámbito académico como escritura, lectura, investigación, estudio, toma de apuntes, preparación de exámenes y en general, ayuda a las estudiantes en todo tipo de avances académicos. Más información en Servicio de Apoyo Académico.

sections.heading: Requisitos de admisión
sections.text:
En nuestro campus hay estudiantes de más de 80 países y aceptamos títulos de secundaria y de grado de miles de instituciones educativas de todo el mundo.
Más información sobre los requisitos para cada país, incluidas las calificaciones específicas necesarias, enlas páginas dedicadas a los países.
Requisitos para estudiantes de grado
Aceptamos títulos de secundaria de todo el mundo, así como A Level y Bachillerato Internacional. Nuestros programas de grado requieren haber cursado asignaturas de Matemáticas e Inglés en secundaria. Además, algunos programas pueden tener requisitos específicos en cuanto a calificaciones.
Requisitos para estudiantes de posgrado
Nuestros programas de máster requieren un título de grado (o equivalente internacional) de una institución reconocida. En las páginas dedicadas a los países se pueden ver los títulos aceptados en cada país, así como las calificaciones exigidas. Además de los requisitos de admisión para cada país, algunos cursos también exigen haber cursado asignaturas relacionadas. Más información en las páginas dedicadas a los programas o en el correo electrónico international@ncirl.ie.
Requisitos de nivel de inglés
Aceptamos varios títulos o certificados, como IELTS, TOEFL y Duolingo. Más información en nuestra página de requisitos de nivel de inglés.

sections.heading: Proceso de solicitud
sections.text:
El National College of Ireland recibe estudiantes de todo el mundo y estamos aquí para apoyarle en cada paso del camino. Recomendamos presentar la solicitud a través de una de nuestras agentes, que puede proporcionar ayuda y asesoramiento adicional. Más información sobre nuestras agentes en las páginas dedicadas a los países. Si no encuentra agentes cerca usted, envíenos un correo electrónico a international@ncirl.ie y le pondremos en contacto con una. También puede ponerse en contacto con nosotros para plantearnos cualquier duda o pregunta sobre su solicitud. Nuestro correo electrónico es international@ncirl.ie.
Si desea presentar su solicitud directamente, sin agente, puede hacerlo a través del botón "Apply Now" en el programa elegido en nuestro sitio web.
Para todas las solicitudes se exige:
Expediente académico y certificado o título oficial de los estudios completados hasta la fecha, tanto en el idioma original como traducidos al inglés.
Certificado o título de nivel de inglés (si dispone de él, si no, puede enviarlo posteriormente).
CV/Hoja de Vida.
Pasaporte (si reside actualmente en Irlanda también necesitaremos una copia de su tarjeta de inmigración).
Para algunos programas se requiere lo siguiente:
Una declaración personal (Grado en Psicología; Grado en Contabilidad y Finanzas; Grado en Marketing; Máster en Tecnología Financiera).
Si la solicitud es para el Máster en Marketing, realizar el trabajo de marketing que se solicita.

sections.heading: Classificações, certificações e qualidade
sections.text:
O Quality and Qualifications Ireland (QQI) é o órgão que aprova os cursos oferecidos pelo National College of Ireland. Nossa parceria com o QQI assegura a conformidade dos cursos de graduação e pós-graduação do NCI com as práticas mais atuais de garantia de qualidade e com os mais altos padrões de integridade acadêmica. Clique aqui para saber mais sobre essa parceria.
Além da parceria com o QQI, nossos cursos são certificados por alguns dos mais importantes órgãos reguladores de setores específicos, entre eles: ACCA, CIPD, Chartered Accountants of Ireland e Psychological Society of Ireland. Essas certificações reconhecem a boa reputação dos cursos do NCI nesses setores.
Recentemente, o NCI recebeu 5 estrelas na categoria QS Stars em Instituições de Ensino Superior. Esse é o melhor resultado que se pode conquistar no setor e reflete o compromisso do NCI em oferecer qualidade em tudo o que faz. A pontuação do NCI destacou-se principalmente nas áreas de emprego para alunos formados, internacionalização, inclusão e instalações. Clique aqui para saber mais a respeito da premiação QS Stars do NCI.

sections.heading: Carreira e inserção profissional
sections.text:
Serviço de carreira do NCI
O NCI compreende a importância de oferecer boas opções de emprego aos alunos assim que eles se formam. É por isso que temos uma equipe exclusiva de carreira que começa a trabalhar com o alunos desde o primeiro dia de sua jornada a fim de oferecer direcionamento, habilidades e conhecimento para identificar com sucesso e seguir na carreira certa. Nossa equipe de carreira recebeu oito prêmios nos últimos nove anos, portanto, você pode ficar tranquilo que receberá o melhor serviço possível. A equipe organiza mais de cem eventos de carreira por ano, conectando os alunos a possíveis empregadores e oferecendo auxílio exclusivo com a preparação de currículos e práticas de entrevista.
Resultados de ex-alunos
Tendo em vista os diplomas de alta qualidade, reconhecidos mundialmente, e o excelente serviço do nosso departamento de carreira, não é de surpreender que 86% dos nossos alunos conseguem se empregar em até 6 meses após a formatura. Esse é um número excepcionalmente alto no setor de ensino superior e motivo de muito orgulho para o NCI. Muitos dos alunos que se formaram aqui trabalham agora em grandes multinacionais de tecnologia e serviços financeiros com sede em Dublin. Para saber mais sobre o sucesso de nossos ex-alunos, leia os relatórios de destinos de ex-alunos.
Visto de trabalho para alunos formados
Para ajudar os alunos após a formatura, o governo da Irlanda oferece um ano de visto de trabalho para alunos da graduação e dois anos para alunos da pós-graduação após a formatura no NCI. Isso permite que os alunos ganhem valiosa experiência de trabalho na Irlanda e comprova nosso compromisso em atrair e receber os alunos internacionais de maior talento.

sections.heading: Apoio estudantil do NCI
sections.text:
Sabemos que a mudança para um novo país, onde você talvez não tenha parentes ou amigos, pode ser assustadora. O Departamento Internacional do NCI garantirá que você tenha todas as informações, apoio e orientação necessários desde a sua chegada à Irlanda até o dia da formatura. A equipe internacional do NCI ganhou o primeiro lugar no The Education Awards 2021 com o prêmio Engajamento Internacional — prova do nosso compromisso em oferecer apoio de destaque a nossos alunos.
Programa de preparação
A partir de doze semanas antes do início das aulas, começamos a enviar aos candidatos informações importantes que os ajudarão a planejar a jornada para o NCI e para a Irlanda. Toda semana, a equipe de apoio internacional lhe fornece informações e guias que abrangem diferentes assuntos, tais como acomodação, finanças, carreira, matrícula e início das aulas no NCI. Organizamos webinars semanais que oferecem aos alunos a oportunidade de fazer perguntas ou tirar dúvidas com a equipe de apoio internacional e atuais alunos do NCI.
Recepção no aeroporto
O serviço de transporte do aeroporto é disponibilizado aos alunos sem custo algum. Nossa equipe de motoristas encontrará você no aeroporto e o transportará com segurança até a sua acomodação em Dublin, fazendo com que sua chegada à Irlanda seja tranquila e prazerosa.
Programa de chegada e boas-vindas
O Departamento Internacional realiza um programa de boas-vindas para os novos alunos internacionais que entram no NCI em setembro ou janeiro de cada ano. Ele acontece ao longo de várias semanas e tem início na primeira semana de setembro e janeiro. O programa inclui vários assuntos essenciais e ótimas atividades que asseguram aos alunos um excelente início de ano e adaptação à vida escolar em Dublin.
Serviços de apoio acadêmico
O NCI tem o compromisso de garantir que todo aluno se sinta apoiado de todas as formas possíveis, principalmente em relação ao sucesso acadêmico. O Serviço de Apoio ao Ensino concentra-se em áreas centrais, como redação acadêmica, leitura, pesquisa, estudo, anotações, revisão para provas e, de modo geral, em ajudar o aluno em todas as formas de crescimento acadêmico. Saiba mais a respeito em serviços de apoio estudantil.

sections.heading: Requisitos de ingresso
sections.text:
Recebemos alunos de mais de 80 países no nosso campus e aceitamos certificados de conclusão de ensino médio de milhares de instituições em todo o mundo.
Para obter todos os detalhes dos requisitos do seu país, inclusive as notas específicas necessárias, acesse as páginas de países.
Requisitos de ingresso na graduação
Aceitamos certificados de conclusão de ensino médio de todo o mundo, bem como as qualificações A Level e International Baccalaureate. Nossos cursos de graduação exigem que você tenha concluído as disciplinas de Matemática e Inglês no ensino médio e alguns cursos podem apresentar requisitos de notas específicas.
Requisitos de ingresso na pós-graduação
Nossos cursos de mestrado exigem que os alunos tenham um diploma de bacharel (ou equivalente internacional) de uma instituição reconhecida. Para saber quais são os certificados aceitos do seu país, bem como as notas necessárias, acesse as páginas de países. Além dos requisitos de ingresso de cada país, determinados cursos também apresentam requisitos respectivos. Recomendamos que você acesse as páginas dos cursos para saber mais ou envie um e-mail para international@ncirl.ie
Requisito do idioma inglês
Aceitamos diversos certificados do idioma inglês, tais como IELTS, TOEFL e Duolingo. Acesse a página de requisitos do idioma inglês para saber mais.

sections.heading: Como solicitar a matrícula
sections.text:
O National College of Ireland recebe alunos de todo o mundo e está à disposição para ajudar você em cada etapa da sua jornada. Recomendamos que você realize a solicitação de matrícula com um dos agentes autorizados que poderão lhe oferecer orientação e apoio com sua inscrição. Consulte nossos agentes nas páginas de países. Caso não encontre um agente próximo, envie um e-mail para international@ncirl.ie e colocaremos você em contato com o agente apropriado. Teremos o prazer de conversar sobre a sua inscrição e qualquer dúvida que você tenha. Envie um e-mail para international@ncirl.ie
Caso queira solicitar a matrícula sem um agente, basta clicar no botão “Inscrever-se agora” no curso escolhido em nosso site.
Exigimos a seguinte documentação em todas as inscrições:
Histórico e certificado de graduação oficial contendo todos os estudos concluídos até então, no idioma original e tradução para o inglês.
Histórico e certificado de graduação oficial contendo todos os estudos concluídos até então, no idioma original e tradução para o inglês.

NCI 为国际学生提供非常合理的费用。所有课程都设有奖学金，在申请过程中考核。因此，如欲获得奖学金，第一步则为申请自己所选的课程。在我们的
费用及经费支持页面
，可查看费用和奖学金的完整列表。

职业及就业
NCI 职业发展服务
NCI 理解，在学生毕业时，为其提供好的职业选择，是非常重要的方面，因此，我们专门设有职业发展团队，在学生入学之初便为他们成功发现并获得好的职业发展，提供方向、技能及知识。我们的职业发展团队，在过去的九年中，获得八项国家奖项，因此可保证您获得最好的服务。每年会举行超过一百项职业发展活动，为学生与潜在雇主之间建立链接，并提供简历及面试方面的指导。
毕业生情况
由于我们提供全球认可、高质量的资质，以及优秀的职业发展服务，86% 的毕业生在毕业 6 个月之内，便获得工作。在高等教育产业，这是非常出色的成绩，NCI 以此为傲。目前，我们的毕业生中，很多在科技及金融服务方面的顶级跨国公司工作，这些公司的总部设在都柏林。请阅读我们的
毕业生走向报告
，了解更多有关毕业生的情况。
毕业后的工作签证
为支持毕业生就业，在学生从 NCI 毕业后，爱尔兰政府为本科生提供一年的工作签证，为研究生提供两年。这可使学生获得珍贵的爱尔兰工作经历，也是我们致力于吸引和欢迎优秀留学生的最佳证明。
NCI 学生支持
我们理解，来到无亲无故的新国家，会充满挑战。NCI 国际生办公室，则会确保您从来到爱尔兰、直至从 NCI 毕业，获得所有所需的信息、支持及指导。NCI 国际生办公室的团队，在2021年教育评选中获得 International Engagement Award 第一名，这是我们致力提供一流学生支持的佐证。
准备事宜
从开课之前的12周起，我们便开始与所有申请人联系，提供重要的信息，帮助他们规划到达 NCI 和爱尔兰的事宜。国际生支持团队，每周会提供信息和指导，包括住宿、资金、职业发展、到校注册、开始 NCI 的学习等方面。我们每两周会举办网上研讨会，国际生支持团队及 NCI 的在校学生，会为同学答疑解惑。
机场交通
我们为学生提供免费的机场接驳服务。司机会在机场与您会面，并将您安全送至都柏林的住宿地点，以便您轻松舒适地来到爱尔兰。
到校及迎新
对于每年九月或一月入学的国际学生，国际生办公室会为新生举办欢迎活动。这些活动从九月或一月的第一个星期，举办几个星期的时间。活动包括一系列的主题和项目，确保学生有最好的学习开端，并在都柏林大学生活中安顿下来。
学术支持服务
NCI 致力于确保每位学生在多个方面获得支持，尤其在学习方面。NCI 学习支持服务，主要围绕几个核心方面，如学术写作、阅读、研究、学习方法、做笔记、考试复习，聚焦学生学术发展的各个方面。请在我们的
学生支持服务
，查询更多信息。
入学要求
我们的校园有来自80多个国家的学生，接受全世界成千上万所学校的高中及大学资质。
有关您所在国家的要求，包括具体的分数要求，详情参见我们的
国家页面
。
本科入学要求
我们接受全世界的高中毕业证书，以及 A Level 和 International Baccalaureate 证书。我们的本科课程，要求高中期间完成数学及英语学科，一些专业可能会有具体的分数要求。
研究生入学要求
我们的硕士课程，需要公认学校的学士学位（或同等学位）。有关您所在的国家认可的证书，以及相应的分数要求，请查看我们的国家页面。除了针对各个国家的入学要求之外，一些课程亦有相关的要求。应当查看
课程页面
，了解更多信息，或发送电子邮件至 international@ncirl.ie
英语要求
我们接受多种英语语言证书，包括雅思、托福及 Duolingo。请查看我们的
英语语言要求页面
，了解更多详情。
如何申请
爱尔兰国家学院欢迎全球的学生，并乐意在您求学的每一步，提供支持。我们建议，通过我们官方认可的中介进行申请，他们可为您的申请提供更多指引和支持。请在
国家页面
，浏览我们的中介机构。若无法找到您附近的中介，请发送电子邮件至
international@ncirl.ie
，我们会帮您与适合的中介机构联系起来。若有任何疑问，我们很乐意与您讨论申请事宜。请通过
international@ncirl.ie
向我们发送电子邮件。
若希望不通过中介机构而自行申请，则可在网站上的
所选课程
页面，点击 “立刻申请”。
对于所有申请，我们要求：
目前所完成的所有学习阶段，相应的成绩单和毕业证，包括原件及英文翻译。
英语语言证书（若无此证书，可在之后上传）
个人简历
护照（若目前在爱尔兰居住，亦需要移民卡的复印件）
对于一些课程，需要以下文件：
一份个人陈述（心理学文学学士（荣誉）、会计及金融文学学士（荣誉）、市场营销实务文学学士（荣誉）、金融科技理学硕士）
若申请市场营销理学硕士，需要完成
市场营销任务

sections.heading: Programlar, Ücretler ve Burslar
sections.text:
Alanında uzman akademik kadrosuyla NCI; İşletme Fakültesi, Bilişim Fakültesi ile Eğitim ve Yaşam Boyu Öğrenme Merkezi bünyesinde lisans, yüksek lisans ve yüksek diploma programları sunmaktadır. Tüm yeterlilikler dünya çapında tanınır ve üstün kalitede mükemmel bir öğrenim deneyimi garanti edilir. Uluslararası öğrencilere sunulan programların listesi aşağıda yer almaktadır. Program sayfamızı ziyaret ederek tüm programlar hakkında ayrıntılı bilgiye ulaşabilirsiniz.
Programlar, genellikle Eylül ayında başlarken bazı Yüksek Lisans programları Ocak ayında başlamaktadır. Lisans programlarımız İşletme Fakültemizde 3 yıl, Bilişim Fakültemiz ile Eğitim ve Hayat Boyu Öğrenme Merkezimizde ise 4 yıldır. Yüksek lisans ve yüksek diploma programlarının süresi genellikle bir yıldır. İşletme Fakültesi'nde Ocak ayında başlayan program ise daha uzundur.
Size kolaylık sağlamak için program başlıkları İngilizce'den çevrilmiştir. Çeviriden kaynaklı olabilecek herhangi bir karışıklığı önlemek için lütfen program sayfalarımızdan programın tam başlığını, İngilizce olarak kontrol ettiğinizden emin olun.

sections.heading: Dereceler, Akreditasyonlar ve Kalite
sections.text:
İrlanda Kalite ve Nitelikler(İKN), İrlanda Ulusal Üniversitesi tarafından sunulan programları yetkilendiren belgelendirme kuruluşudur. İKN ile olan yakın ortaklığımız, NCI'nin lisans ve lisansüstü programlarının en güncel kalite güvencesinde, en yüksek akademik dürüstlük standartlarına uygun sunulmasını sağlar. Ortaklık ile ilgili daha fazla bilgi almak için lütfen burayı tıklayın.
İKN ile olan ortaklığımızın yanı sıra programlarımız, ACCA, CIPD, İrlanda Yeminli Mali Müşavirler ve İrlanda Psikoloji Derneği dahil olmak üzere belirli endüstrilerdeki önde gelen yetkili kuruluşlar tarafından akredite edilmiştir. Bu akreditasyonlar, NCI programlarının bu endüstrilerde saygıyla kabul edildiğinin göstergesidir.
NCI, yakın zamanda Yüksek Öğrenim Kurumları, QS Stars derecelendirmesinde 5 Yıldız ile ödüllendirildi. Bu eğitim öğretim alanında alınabilecek en yüksek başarıdır ve NCI’nin yüksek kalitede hizmet sunmaya olan bağlılığının bir göstergesidir. İUÜ, özellikle şu alanlarda iyi puanlar alarak başarısını kanıtlamıştır: mezun istihdamı, uluslararasılaştırma, kapsayıcılık ve olanaklar. NCI'nin QS Stars başarısı hakkında buradandaha fazla bilgi edinebilirsiniz.

sections.heading: Kariyer ve İstihdam
sections.text:
NCI Kariyer servisi
NCI olarak öğrencilere mezun olduklarında iyi kariyer seçenekleri sunmanın önemini anlıyoruz. Bu sebeple öğrencilerin kariyerlerini başarılı bir şekilde belirlemek ve güvence altına almak konusunda yön gösteren, gerekli beceri ve bilgileri sağlayan, öğrencilik hayatlarının ilk gününden itibaren onlarla çalışmaya başlayan uzman Kariyer Ekibimiz bulunmaktadır. Kariyer ekibimiz son dokuz yılda sekiz ulusal ödül kazanarak en iyi hizmeti alacağınızın garantisini vermektedir. Ekibimiz her yıl öğrencileri potansiyel işverenlerle buluşturan yüzden fazla etkinlik hazırlar ve özgeçmiş koçluğu, mülakat pratiği uygulamalarıyla uzman destek sağlar.
Mezun Başarıları
Dünya çapında tanınan, yüksek kaliteli nitelikleri ve kariyer departmanımızın sunduğu olağanüstü hizmetin bir sonucu olarak, mezunlarımızın %86'si mezuniyetten sonraki 6 ay içinde iş bulabilmektedir. Yüksek öğrenim endüstrisinde bu, NCI olarak gurur duyduğumuz, son derece başarılı bir sonuçtur. Mezunlarımızın birçoğu, teknoloji ve finans sektöründe, alanında lider, merkezleri Dublin'de bulunan, çok uluslu şirketlerde çalışmaktadır. Mezunlarımızın başarıları hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için mezun başarı raporlarımızı okuyabilirsiniz.
Mezun çalışma vizesi
İrlanda Hükümeti, öğrencileri mezun olduklarında desteklemek için, NCI'den mezuniyetlerini takiben, lisans öğrencileri için bir yıllık ve lisansüstü öğrenciler için iki yıllık çalışma vizesi olanağı sunmaktadır. Vize olanakları, öğrencilerin İrlanda'da paha biçilmez bir çalışma deneyimi kazanmalarına yardımcı olur. Bu durum, en yetenekli uluslararası öğrencileri cezbetme ve onlara iyi olanaklar sağlama konusundaki kararlılığımızın kanıtıdır.

sections.heading: NCI Öğrenci Raporu
sections.text:
Ailenizin veya arkadaşlarınızın olmadığı yeni bir ülkeye taşınmanın ne kadar zor olabileceğini anlıyoruz. NCI Uluslararası Ofisi, İrlanda'ya gelişinizden NCI'den mezun olana kadar geçen sürede ihtiyacınız olan tüm bilgi, destek ve rehberliği sağlayacaktır. İÜU Uluslararası ekibi 2021 Eğitim Ödülleri kapsamında Uluslararası Katılım Ödülü’nde birincilik kazanmıştır. Bu da, olağanüstü öğrenci desteği sağlama konusundaki taahhüdümüzün kanıtıdır.
Okula Hazırlık
Derslerin başlamasından on iki hafta önce, tüm başvuru sahipleriyle, NCI ve İrlanda'ya seyahatin planlanmasına yardımcı olmak için önemli bilgiler hakkında görüşmeye başlıyoruz. Uluslararası destek ekibi, size her hafta konaklama, finans, kariyer, kayıt ve NCI'ye başlama gibi farklı konuları kapsayan bilgilendirme sağlar. Düzenlediğimiz haftalık web seminerleri ile yeni öğrencileri, Uluslararası destek ekibi ve mevcut NCI öğrencileri ile buluşturuyor ve onlara akıllarındaki soruları sorma ve bilgi edinme fırsatı sunuyoruz.
Havaalanında Karşılama
Öğrenciler için ücretsiz havaalanı transfer servisimiz bulunmaktadır. Sürücü ekibimiz, sizi havaalanında karşılayarak Dublin'deki konaklamanıza güvenli bir şekilde ulaştıracaktır. Böylece İrlanda'ya gelişinizde stres yaşamayacaksınız.
Karşılama ve Hoş Geldin Programı
Her yılın Eylül veya Ocak aylarında NCI'ye katılan yeni uluslararası öğrenciler için Uluslararası Ofis Hoş Geldin Programı düzenler. Bu program, Eylül ve Ocak aylarının ilk haftasında başlar ve birkaç hafta sürer. Program, öğrencilerin önümüzdeki yıla en iyi şekilde başlamalarını ve Dublin'deki üniversite hayatına alışmalarını sağlayan temel konuları ve birçok harika etkinliği kapsar.
Akademik Destek Hizmetleri
NCI, özellikle akademik başarı söz konusu olduğunda, her öğrencinin mümkün olduğunca desteklendiğini hissetmesini sağlamaya kendini adamıştır. NCI'nin Öğrenim Destek Hizmeti, akademik yazma, okuma, araştırma, çalışma, not alma, sınav revizyonu gibi temel alanlar etrafında toplanmıştır ve genel olarak, bir öğrenciye her türlü akademik ilerlemede yardımcı olmayı hedeflemektedir. öğrenci destek hizmetlerimiz hakkında daha fazla bilgiye göz atın.

sections.heading: Başvuru Koşulları
sections.text:
80'den fazla ülkeden öğrenci kampüsümüzde eğitim görmektedir. Dünya çapındaki binlerce eğitim kurumundan lise ve eğitim derecesi yeterliliklerini kabul etmekteyiz.
Gerekli not ortalamaları da dahil olmak üzere ülkenizin gereksinimleriyle ilgili tüm ayrıntılar için Ülke Sayfalarımızı ziyaret edin.
Lisans Başvuru Koşulları
Dünyanın dört bir yanından lise yeterliliklerinin yanı sıra A Düzeyi ve Uluslararası Bakalorya yeterliliklerini de kabul ediyoruz. Lisans programları için Matematik ve İngilizce derslerinin lise müfredatında tamamlanmış olması gerekir. Bunun yanında bazı programlar için belirli not ortalaması koşulları gerekli olabilir.
Lisansüstü Başvuru Koşulları
Yüksek lisans programlarımız için öğrencilerin tanınmış bir kurumdan lisans derecesine veya uluslararası eşdeğeri bir dereceye sahip olmaları gereklidir. Ülkenizden kabul edilen nitelikleri ve gerekli not ortalamalarını öğrenmek için Ülke Sayfalarımızı ziyaret edebilirsiniz. Ülkelere göre değişen şartlara ek olarak bazı bölümlerde ilgili uzmanlıklara sahip olma şartları da yer almaktadır. Daha fazla bilgi için program sayfalarını ziyaret edebilir veya international@ncirl.ie adresine e-posta gönderebilirsiniz.
İngilizce Dil Yeterlilik Koşulları
IELTS, TOEFL ve Duolingo dahil olmak üzere birçok İngilizce dil yeterlilik sertifikasını kabul ediyoruz. Daha fazla ayrıntı için İngilizce dil gereksinimleri sayfamızı ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

sections.heading: Nasıl Başvurulur?
sections.text:
Ulusal İrlanda Üniversitesi olarak dünyanın dört bir yanından gelen öğrencilere ev sahipliği yapıyoruz. Yolculuğunuzun her adımında sizi desteklemek için buradayız. Başvuru sürecinde ek rehberlik ve destek sağlayan onaylı danışman kurumlar aracılığıyla başvuruda bulunmanızı tavsiye ederiz. Danışmanlarımızı Ülke Sayfalarımızda görüntüleyebilirsiniz. Yakınınızda bir danışman bulamadığınız takdirde uygun bir danışmanla buluşturabilmemiz için international@ncirl.ie adresinden e-posta gönderebilirsiniz. Başvuru detaylarını ve aklınıza takılabilecek tüm soruları konuşmaktan memnuniyet duyarız. Bize international@ncirl.ieadresinden e-posta gönderebilirsiniz.
Danışmanlık kurumu olmadan bireysel başvuru yapmak isterseniz, web sitemizdeki seçtiğiniz programın sayfasından "Şimdi Başvur" düğmesinden başvurabilirsiniz.

Bu bölümün yurt dışı eğitim araştırmalarınız için faydalı olacağını umarız. Alternatif seçenekler ile ilgiil ayrıntılı bilgi almak için bizimle iletişime geçin international@ncirl.ie

Programlar, Ücretler ve Burslar
Alanında uzman akademik kadrosuyla NCI; İşletme Fakültesi, Bilişim Fakültesi ile Eğitim ve Yaşam Boyu Öğrenme Merkezi bünyesinde lisans, yüksek lisans ve yüksek diploma programları sunmaktadır. Tüm yeterlilikler dünya çapında tanınır ve üstün kalitede mükemmel bir öğrenim deneyimi garanti edilir. Uluslararası öğrencilere sunulan programların listesi aşağıda yer almaktadır.
Program sayfamızı
ziyaret ederek tüm programlar hakkında ayrıntılı bilgiye ulaşabilirsiniz.
Programlar, genellikle Eylül ayında başlarken bazı Yüksek Lisans programları Ocak ayında başlamaktadır. Lisans programlarımız İşletme Fakültemizde 3 yıl, Bilişim Fakültemiz ile Eğitim ve Hayat Boyu Öğrenme Merkezimizde ise 4 yıldır. Yüksek lisans ve yüksek diploma programlarının süresi genellikle bir yıldır. İşletme Fakültesi'nde Ocak ayında başlayan program ise daha uzundur.
Size kolaylık sağlamak için program başlıkları İngilizce'den çevrilmiştir.  Çeviriden kaynaklı olabilecek herhangi bir karışıklığı önlemek için lütfen

Ücretler ve Burslar
NCI, uluslararası öğrenciler için oldukça avantajlı ücretler sunar. Tüm programlarda burs olanakları mevcuttur. Burslar başvuru sürecinde değerlendirilir. Bu nedenle burs kazanmanın ilk adımı, seçtiğiniz bir programa başvurmaktır. Ücretlerimizin ve burslarımızın tam listesi
Ücretler ve Finansman sayfalarında
mevcuttur.
Dereceler, Akreditasyonlar ve Kalite
İrlanda Kalite ve Nitelikler(İKN), İrlanda Ulusal Üniversitesi tarafından sunulan programları yetkilendiren belgelendirme kuruluşudur. İKN ile olan yakın ortaklığımız, NCI'nin lisans ve lisansüstü programlarının en güncel kalite güvencesinde, en yüksek akademik dürüstlük standartlarına uygun sunulmasını sağlar. Ortaklık ile ilgili daha fazla bilgi almak için lütfen
burayı tıklayın
.
İKN ile olan ortaklığımızın yanı sıra programlarımız, ACCA, CIPD, İrlanda Yeminli Mali Müşavirler ve İrlanda Psikoloji Derneği dahil olmak üzere belirli endüstrilerdeki önde gelen yetkili kuruluşlar tarafından akredite edilmiştir. Bu akreditasyonlar, NCI programlarının bu endüstrilerde saygıyla kabul edildiğinin göstergesidir.
NCI, yakın zamanda Yüksek Öğrenim Kurumları, QS Stars derecelendirmesinde 5 Yıldız ile ödüllendirildi. Bu eğitim öğretim alanında alınabilecek en yüksek başarıdır ve NCI’nin yüksek kalitede hizmet sunmaya olan bağlılığının bir göstergesidir. İUÜ, özellikle şu alanlarda iyi puanlar alarak başarısını kanıtlamıştır: mezun istihdamı, uluslararasılaştırma, kapsayıcılık ve olanaklar. NCI'nin QS Stars başarısı hakkında
buradan
daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsiniz.
Kariyer ve İstihdam
NCI Kariyer servisi
NCI olarak öğrencilere mezun olduklarında iyi kariyer seçenekleri sunmanın önemini anlıyoruz. Bu sebeple öğrencilerin kariyerlerini başarılı bir şekilde belirlemek ve güvence altına almak konusunda yön gösteren, gerekli beceri ve bilgileri sağlayan, öğrencilik hayatlarının ilk gününden itibaren onlarla çalışmaya başlayan uzman Kariyer Ekibimiz bulunmaktadır. Kariyer ekibimiz son dokuz yılda sekiz ulusal ödül kazanarak en iyi hizmeti alacağınızın garantisini vermektedir. Ekibimiz her yıl öğrencileri potansiyel işverenlerle buluşturan yüzden fazla etkinlik hazırlar ve özgeçmiş koçluğu, mülakat pratiği uygulamalarıyla uzman destek sağlar.
Mezun Başarıları
Dünya çapında tanınan, yüksek kaliteli nitelikleri ve kariyer departmanımızın sunduğu olağanüstü hizmetin bir sonucu olarak, mezunlarımızın %86'si mezuniyetten sonraki 6 ay içinde iş bulabilmektedir. Yüksek öğrenim endüstrisinde bu, NCI olarak gurur duyduğumuz, son derece başarılı bir sonuçtur. Mezunlarımızın birçoğu, teknoloji ve finans sektöründe, alanında lider, merkezleri Dublin'de bulunan, çok uluslu şirketlerde çalışmaktadır. Mezunlarımızın başarıları hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için
mezun başarı raporlarımızı
okuyabilirsiniz.
Mezun çalışma vizesi
İrlanda Hükümeti, öğrencileri mezun olduklarında desteklemek için, NCI'den mezuniyetlerini takiben, lisans öğrencileri için bir yıllık ve lisansüstü öğrenciler için iki yıllık çalışma vizesi olanağı sunmaktadır. Vize olanakları, öğrencilerin İrlanda'da paha biçilmez bir çalışma deneyimi kazanmalarına yardımcı olur. Bu durum, en yetenekli uluslararası öğrencileri cezbetme ve onlara iyi olanaklar sağlama konusundaki kararlılığımızın kanıtıdır.
NCI Öğrenci Raporu
Ailenizin veya arkadaşlarınızın olmadığı yeni bir ülkeye taşınmanın ne kadar zor olabileceğini anlıyoruz. NCI Uluslararası Ofisi, İrlanda'ya gelişinizden NCI'den mezun olana kadar geçen sürede ihtiyacınız olan tüm bilgi, destek ve rehberliği sağlayacaktır. İÜU Uluslararası ekibi 2021 Eğitim Ödülleri kapsamında Uluslararası Katılım Ödülü’nde birincilik kazanmıştır. Bu da, olağanüstü öğrenci desteği sağlama konusundaki taahhüdümüzün kanıtıdır.
Okula Hazırlık
Derslerin başlamasından on iki hafta önce, tüm başvuru sahipleriyle, NCI ve İrlanda'ya seyahatin planlanmasına yardımcı olmak için önemli bilgiler hakkında görüşmeye başlıyoruz. Uluslararası destek ekibi, size her hafta konaklama, finans, kariyer, kayıt ve NCI'ye başlama gibi farklı konuları kapsayan bilgilendirme sağlar. Düzenlediğimiz haftalık web seminerleri ile yeni öğrencileri, Uluslararası destek ekibi ve mevcut NCI öğrencileri ile buluşturuyor ve onlara akıllarındaki soruları sorma ve bilgi edinme fırsatı sunuyoruz.
Havaalanında Karşılama
Öğrenciler için ücretsiz havaalanı transfer servisimiz bulunmaktadır. Sürücü ekibimiz, sizi havaalanında karşılayarak Dublin'deki konaklamanıza güvenli bir şekilde ulaştıracaktır. Böylece İrlanda'ya gelişinizde stres yaşamayacaksınız.

sections.heading: Selamat datang di National College of Ireland (NCI)
sections.text:
Pada halaman ini kamu akan menemukan informasi penting mengenai NCI.
Termasuk juga program-program studi, beasiswa, dan dukungan ini dapat membantu kamu untuk mempelajari studi di luar negeri. Hubungi kami untuk mengetahui pilihan lebih lanjut melalui email international@ncirl.ie
NCI adalah perguruan tinggi terspesialisasi dan menyediakan rangkaian program jenjang sarjana, pascasarjana, dan diploma tinggi dalam lingkup Sekolah Bisnis, Sekolah Komputasi, serta Pusat Pendidikan dan Pembelajaran Seumur Hidup kami. Semua kualifikasi di sini diakui secara global, dan kamu dapat mendapatkan jaminan kualitas serta pengalaman belajar yang luar biasa.

sections.heading: Program, Biaya, dan Beasiswa
sections.text:
NCI adalah perguruan tinggi terspesialisasi dan menyediakan rangkaian program jenjang sarjana, pascasarjana, dan diploma tinggi dalam lingkup Sekolah Bisnis, Sekolah Komputasi, serta Pusat Pendidikan dan Pembelajaran Seumur Hidup kami. Semua kualifikasi di sini diakui secara global, dan kamu dapat mendapatkan jaminan kualitas serta pengalaman belajar yang luar biasa. Kamu dapat menemukan daftar semua program yang tersedia bagi mahasiswa internasional dan kamu dapat membaca rincian setiap program lebih lanjut dengan mengunjungi Halaman Program kami.
Semua program dimulai di bulan September setiap tahunnya. Sejumlah program Magister juga dimulai di bulan Januari. Program Sarjana kami berdurasi 3 tahun di Sekolah Bisnis dan 4 tahun di Sekolah Komputasi serta Pusat Pendidikan dan Pembelajaran Seumur Hidup. Program Magister dan Diploma Tinggi biasanya berdurasi 1 tahun, dengan durasi yang lebih panjang untuk Sekolah Bisnis yang dimulai di bulan Januari.
Perlu diperhatikan bahwa judul program ini telah diterjemahkan dari Bahasa Inggris untuk kenyamananmu. Untuk menghindari kebingungan akibat hasil penerjemahan, pastikan kamu memeriksa judul program sebenarnya dalam Bahasa Inggris di Halaman Program kami.
